title: What Are AI Agents? Planning, Tools and Human Oversight | Ep 44
description:
What Are AI Agents? Planning, Tools and Human Oversight. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 44 of 50

What you will learn: Understand systems that plan steps and use tools.
Example: an assistant preparing a draft travel checklist.
Try it: draw a plan-act-check loop.
Remember: agent actions need limits, approvals and monitoring.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
